reviews.review: Preserved wide composition, identity and stair geography. Previously tiny waist prop now hangs visibly below gripping hand with ivory upperpiece, red inset and squared metallic curved lowerleg. Device matches hand-relative approximate scale of ta013.
caveats: Closed grip occludes thumb and some digits; full five-digit count cannot be certified from pose, no clear extra digit.
Credential is proximity access device passed near scanner, never mechanically inserted. Exact close alignment of internal greebles is approximate.
No shotlist or animatic changes made by this worker.

reviews.review: Preserved reverse composition and Taffy identity. Replaced threaded/undersized grip with closed hand over solid upper grip; horseshoe opening below remains clear. Ivory/red/squared metal design now closely matches ta013. No fingers visibly clipping through solid parts.
caveats: Closed grip occludes thumb and some digits; full five-digit count cannot be certified from pose, no clear extra digit.
Credential is proximity access device passed near scanner, never mechanically inserted. Exact close alignment of internal greebles is approximate.
No shotlist or animatic changes made by this worker.

review.scanner: Flat teal ceramic contactless scanner within bronze plate on fixed stone jamb; no shaped socket or insertion. Clear air gap.
review.credential: Ivory top grip held overhand, asymmetrical C/horseshoe metal body hangs down with red indicator, scale consistent with ta013 relative to child hand.
review.anatomy: Four curled finger forms; opposing thumb normally hidden under overhand grip. No obvious extra digits.
review.identity: Taffy broad torso, cheeks, large rounded ears, cheek lines and costume preserved; Harper retained in medium shot, excluded by close crop.
caveats: Scanner bronze mounting trim and bottom fasteners vary slightly between wide and close; teal face and amber indicator stay consistent.
These are starter stills, not proof of completed waving motion or scanner response.
